+import 'package:core/core.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../format.dart';
+import '../../asset_url.dart';
+import '../../widgets/markdown_view.dart';
+import '../../widgets/share/share_image_preview.dart';
+
+/// Share only the public author identity; viewer-local notes never enter PNGs.
+Future<void> showPostShareImage(
+  BuildContext context, {
+  required PostPayload post,
+  required String topicTitle,
+  required String baseUrl,
+  bool topicLink = false,
+}) async {
+  final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+  await showShareImagePreview(
+    context,
+    fileName: 'yourtj-post-${post.topicId}-${post.postNo}.png',
+    cardBuilder: (theme) {
+      final colors = theme.colors;
+      final postUrl = Uri.parse(baseUrl)
+          .replace(
+            path: topicLink
+                ? '/p/post/${post.topicId}'
+                : '/p/post/${post.topicId}/${post.postNo}',
+            query: null,
+            fragment: null,
+          )
+          .toString();
+      // Share cards mirror the reading view's author identity
+      // (anonymous label / nickname / username) so a post looks the same
+      // exported as it does in the app. They deliberately stay clear of
+      // privateDisplayName(): it bakes the viewer's local private notes
+      // into the label, which must never leak into an exported PNG.
+      final author = post.isAnonymous
+          ? l10n.courseCopyAuthorAnonymousLabel
+          : (post.author.nickname?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
+                ? post.author.nickname!.trim()
+                : post.author.username.trim().isNotEmpty
+                ? post.author.username.trim()
+                : l10n.courseCopyAuthorAnonymousLabel);
+      return ShareImageCard(
+        theme: theme,
+        child: Column(
+          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+          children: [
+            GfText(
+              topicTitle,
+              style: TextStyle(
+                color: colors.baseContent,
+                fontSize: 22,
+                height: 1.3,
+                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
+              ),
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            Row(
+              children: [
+                if (post.isAnonymous)
+                  CircleAvatar(
+                    radius: 18,
+                    backgroundColor: colors.base200,
+                    child: GfSymbol(
+                      'user-round',
+                      size: 18,
+                      color: colors.iconMuted,
+                    ),
+                  )
+                else
+                  ClipOval(
+                    child: ShareImageNetworkImage(
+                      resolveApiAssetUrl(post.author.avatarUrl),
+                      width: 36,
+                      height: 36,
+                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
+                      errorBuilder: (_) => CircleAvatar(
+                        radius: 18,
+                        backgroundColor: colors.base200,
+                        child: GfSymbol(
+                          'user-round',
+                          size: 18,
+                          color: colors.iconMuted,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                const SizedBox(width: 10),
+                Expanded(
+                  child: Column(
+                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                    children: [
+                      GfText(
+                        author,
+                        style: TextStyle(
+                          color: colors.baseContent,
+                          fontSize: 14,
+                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                      GfText(
+                        '#${post.postNo} · ${timeAgo(post.createdAt, l10n: l10n)}',
+                        style: TextStyle(color: colors.iconMuted, fontSize: 12),
+                      ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ],
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 16),
+            GfMarkdownView(
+              data: post.content,
+              mentions: post.mentions,
+              screenshot: true,
+              colors: colors,
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            GfText(
+              postUrl,
+              style: TextStyle(color: colors.primary, fontSize: 11),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      );
+    },
+  );
+}

+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final glass = GfNavigationSurface.usesGlass(context);
+    return IgnorePointer(
+      child: AnimatedBuilder(
+        animation: animation,
+        builder: (context, _) {
+          final t = animation.value;
+          final dim = ColoredBox(
+            color: glass
+                // The frost already separates the menu; dim less than a sheet.
+                ? Colors.black.withValues(
+                    alpha: (colors.isDark ? 0.5 : 0.2) * t,
+                  )
+                : colors.scrim.withValues(alpha: colors.scrim.a * t),
+            child: const SizedBox.expand(),
+          );
+          if (!glass || t == 0) return dim;
+          return BackdropFilter(
+            filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 8 * t, sigmaY: 8 * t),
+            child: dim,
+          );
+        },
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// Menu items grow out of the action below them: each rises a little and
+/// scales up from its trailing bottom corner, nearest first. They leave
+/// together, softer than they arrived.
+class _RiseFromAction extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _RiseFromAction({
+    required this.animation,
+    required this.order,
+    required this.child,
+  });
+
+  final Animation<double> animation;
+  final int order;
+  final Widget child;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final start = math.min(0.4, order * 0.12);
+    final enter = Interval(
+      start,
+      math.min(1, start + 0.6),
+      curve: GfMotion.enterCurve,
+    );
+    return AnimatedBuilder(
+      animation: animation,
+      builder: (context, child) {
+        final leaving = animation.status == AnimationStatus.reverse;
+        final t = leaving
+            ? Curves.easeOutCubic.transform(animation.value)
+            : enter.transform(animation.value);
+        return Opacity(
+          opacity: t.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
+          child: Transform.translate(
+            offset: Offset(0, (leaving ? 4 : 10) * (1 - t)),
+            child: Transform.scale(
+              scale: leaving ? 1 : 0.92 + 0.08 * t,
+              alignment: AlignmentDirectional.bottomEnd.resolve(
+                Directionality.of(context),
+              ),
+              child: child,
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+      },
+      child: child,
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// The opening action's plus turns a quarter of the way round into the close
+/// mark, and back as the menu closes.
+class _PlusToClose extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _PlusToClose({required this.animation});
+
+  final Animation<double> animation;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final color = GfTheme.colorsOf(context).primaryContent;
+    return AnimatedBuilder(
+      animation: animation,
+      builder: (context, _) {
+        final t = GfMotion.enterCurve.transform(animation.value.clamp(0, 1));
+        return Stack(
+          alignment: Alignment.center,
+          children: [
+            Opacity(
+              opacity: 1 - t,
+              child: Transform.rotate(
+                angle: math.pi / 4 * t,
+                child: GfSymbol('plus', size: 28, color: color),
+              ),
+            ),
+            Opacity(
+              opacity: t,
+              child: Transform.rotate(
+                angle: -math.pi / 4 * (1 - t),
+                child: GfSymbol('x', size: 28, color: color),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ],
+        );
+      },
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:forum_app/src/app_config.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  test('dev config requires the preview flag and official dev endpoints', () {
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: true,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      returnsNormally,
+    );
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: false,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: true,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://example.com',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://example.com/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('production config cannot connect to the dev API', () {
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'production',
+        preview: false,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );
+  });
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+
+import 'catalog.dart';
+import 'mock.dart';
+import 'screens.dart';
+
+/// Preview with `flutter run --route '/settings?theme=dark&y=640'`.
+void main() {
+  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
+  final route = Uri.tryParse(
+    WidgetsBinding.instance.platformDispatcher.defaultRouteName,
+  );
+  galleryLaunchPage = route?.pathSegments.lastOrNull;
+  galleryInitialScroll =
+      double.tryParse(route?.queryParameters['y'] ?? '') ?? 0;
+  if (route?.queryParameters['theme'] == 'dark') {
+    galleryThemeMode.value = ThemeMode.dark;
+  }
+  runApp(const GalleryApp());
+}
+
+String? galleryLaunchPage;
+
+final ValueNotifier<ThemeMode> galleryThemeMode = ValueNotifier(
+  ThemeMode.light,
+);
+
+class GalleryPage {
+  const GalleryPage(
+    this.id,
+    this.title,
+    this.subtitle,
+    this.symbol,
+    this.build,
+  );
+  final String id;
+  final String title;
+  final String subtitle;
+  final String symbol;
+  final WidgetBuilder build;
+}
+
+final List<GalleryPage> catalogPages = [
+  GalleryPage(
+    'foundations',
+    '基础',
+    '颜色角色 · 字号 · 圆角 · 间距 · 阴影',
+    'palette',
+    (_) => const FoundationsPage(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'buttons',
+    '按钮与操作',
+    '按钮 · 图标按钮 · 浮动按钮 · 导航文字操作',
+    'square-pen',
+    (_) => const ButtonsPage(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'inputs',
+    '表单与选择',
+    '输入框 · 搜索 · 分段 · 标签 · 开关',
+    'type',
+    (_) => const InputsPage(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'feedback',
+    '标签与反馈',
+    '徽标 · 计数 · 分类 · 提示条 · 轻提示 · 空状态',
+    'circle-alert',
+    (_) => const FeedbackPage(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'lists',
+    '列表与分组',
+    '分组列表 · 设置行 · 通知行 · 会话行',
+    'list',
+    (_) => const ListsPage(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'overlays',
+    '浮层',
+    '对话框 · 底部面板 · 菜单 · 操作表',
+    'layers-filled',
+    (_) => const OverlaysPage(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'content',
+    '内容',
+    '帖子卡片 · 消息气泡 · 资料卡',
+    'file-text',
+    (_) => const ContentPage(),
+  ),
+];
+
+final List<GalleryPage> screenPages = [
+  GalleryPage(
+    'profile-edit',
+    '编辑资料',
+    '分组表单 · 封面头像 · 字数统计',
+    'pen-line',
+    (_) => const ProfileEditScreen(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'settings',
+    '设置',
+    '账号卡片 · 分组设置 · 当前值',
+    'settings',
+    (_) => const SettingsScreen(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'profile',
+    '个人主页',
+    '封面 · 资料卡 · 标签页 · 帖子',
+    'user-round',
+    (_) => const ProfileScreen(),

+  GalleryPage(
+    'home',
+    '首页',
+    '排序标签 · 分类 · 帖子流 · 底部导航',
+    'house',
+    (_) => const HomeScreen(),

+    'bell',
+    (_) => const NotificationsScreen(),

+    '私信对话',
+    '气泡 · 时间分组 · 输入栏',

+    (_) => const ChatScreen(),
+  ),

+    '登录',
+    '品牌 · 分段 · 表单 · 主操作',
+    'login4',
+    (_) => const LoginScreen(),
+  ),

+    '对话框示例',
+    '在页面上打开确认对话框',

+  ),

+    'sheet',
+    '底部面板示例',
+    '在页面上打开选择面板',
+    'layers-filled',
+    (_) => const SheetDemoScreen(),
+  ),

+class GalleryApp extends StatelessWidget {
+  const GalleryApp({super.key});
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return ValueListenableBuilder<ThemeMode>(
+      valueListenable: galleryThemeMode,
+      builder: (context, mode, _) => MaterialApp(
+        title: 'Gf Gallery',
+        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
+        theme: gfThemeData(Brightness.light),
+        darkTheme: gfThemeData(Brightness.dark),
+        themeMode: mode,
+        home: _launchHome() ?? const GalleryIndex(),
+        onGenerateRoute: _route,
+        builder: (context, child) {
+          final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
+          return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
+            value: dark
+                ? SystemUiOverlayStyle.light
+                : SystemUiOverlayStyle.dark,
+            child: child!,
+          );
+        },
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  Widget? _launchHome() {
+    final id = galleryLaunchPage;
+    if (id == null) return null;
+    final page = [...catalogPages, ...screenPages].where((p) => p.id == id);
+    return page.isEmpty ? null : Builder(builder: page.first.build);
+  }
+
+  Route<dynamic>? _route(RouteSettings settings) {
+    final uri = Uri.tryParse(settings.name ?? '');
+    if (uri == null) return null;
+    final segments = uri.pathSegments;
+    if (segments.isEmpty) return null;
+    final id = segments.last;
+    galleryInitialScroll = double.tryParse(uri.queryParameters['y'] ?? '') ?? 0;
+    final theme = uri.queryParameters['theme'];
+    if (theme != null) {
+      galleryThemeMode.value = theme == 'dark'
+          ? ThemeMode.dark
+          : ThemeMode.light;
+    }
+    final page = [...catalogPages, ...screenPages].where((p) => p.id == id);
+    if (page.isEmpty) return null;
+    return MaterialPageRoute(builder: page.first.build, settings: settings);
+  }
+}
+
+class GalleryIndex extends StatelessWidget {
+  const GalleryIndex({super.key});
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
+    Widget row(GalleryPage page) => GfSettingRow(
+      leading: GfIconTile(page.symbol, size: 32),
+      title: page.title,
+      description: page.subtitle,
+      onTap: () =>
+          Navigator.of(context).push(MaterialPageRoute(builder: page.build)),
+    );
+    return Scaffold(
+      backgroundColor: colors.canvasGrouped,
+      appBar: GfAppBar(
+        title: const GfText('Gf 组件库'),
+        showDivider: false,
+        backgroundColor: colors.canvasGrouped,
+        actions: [
+          GfIconButton(
+            symbol: dark ? 'sun' : 'moon',
+            tooltip: '切换主题',
+            color: colors.textPrimary,
+            onPressed: () => galleryThemeMode.value = dark
+                ? ThemeMode.light
+                : ThemeMode.dark,
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(width: GfSpace.xs),
+        ],
+      ),
+      body: ListView(
+        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: GfSpace.sm, bottom: GfSpace.xxxl),
+        children: [
+          GfListSection(
+            header: '组件',
+            dividerIndent: GfSpace.lg + 32 + GfSpace.md,
+            children: [for (final page in catalogPages) row(page)],
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: GfSpace.section),
+          GfListSection(
+            header: '示例页面',
+            footer: '示例页面只组合组件库，不含业务逻辑与网络请求以外的数据。',
+            dividerIndent: GfSpace.lg + 32 + GfSpace.md,
+            children: [for (final page in screenPages) row(page)],
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import test from 'node:test'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { checkTokenMirror, normalizeTokenValue } from './check_token_mirror.mjs'
+
+const cssPath = new URL('../../../../gooseforum/resource/src/styles/tokens.css', import.meta.url)
+const tokenPath = new URL('../lib/src/theme/tokens.json', import.meta.url)
+const css = readFileSync(cssPath, 'utf8')
+const tokens = JSON.parse(readFileSync(tokenPath, 'utf8'))
+
+// Known sRGB references, not values calculated by the implementation under test.
+test('normalizes the supported CSS values into the existing mobile representation', () => {
+  for (const [value, expected] of [
+    ['#ABCDEF', '#abcdef'], ['oklch(100% 0 0)', '#ffffff'],
+    ['oklch(0 0 0)', '#000000'], ['oklch(50% 0 0)', '#636363'],
+    ['oklch(54.6% 0.215 262.88)', '#2563eb'],
+    ['oklch(62.7% 0.194 149.214)', '#00a63e'],
+  ]) assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('color-primary', value), expected)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('radius-box', '0.5rem'), 8)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('border', '1px'), 1)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('depth', '1'), 1)
+})
+
+test('unsupported or invalid values fail rather than silently skipping equality', () => {
+  for (const value of ['red', '#fff', 'var(--other)', 'oklch(50% 0.1 0 / .5)', 'oklch(101% 0 0)', 'oklch(50% -1 0)']) {
+    assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('color-primary', value), /Unsupported/)
+  }
+  for (const value of ['calc(1rem)', '1em', 'NaN', '1px junk', '8']) {
+    assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('radius-box', value), /Unsupported/)
+  }
+  assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('depth', '1px'), /Unsupported/)
+})
+
+test('checked-in mirror equals both resolved web themes and CLI works outside the repository', () => {
+  checkTokenMirror(css, tokens)
+  const output = execFileSync(process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(new URL('check_token_mirror.mjs', import.meta.url))], { cwd: tmpdir(), encoding: 'utf8' })
+  assert.match(output, /Token mirror: light and dark values match/)
+})
+
+for (const theme of ['light', 'dark']) {
+  for (const key of ['color-primary', 'color-tooltip-bg', 'radius-box', 'depth']) {
+    test(`detects a changed mobile value: ${theme}/${key}`, () => {
+      const changed = structuredClone(tokens)
+      changed[theme][key] = key.startsWith('color-') ? '#ffffff' : 9
+      assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, changed), new RegExp(`${theme}/${key}`))
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+test('detects a web-only change without changing the mobile mirror', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('oklch(54.6% 0.215 262.88)', '#ffffff'), tokens), /light\/color-primary/)
+})
+
+test('dark inherits root geometry and static colors, but explicit overrides win', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-radius-box: 0.5rem', '--gf-radius-box: 1rem'), tokens), /light\/radius-box[\s\S]*dark\/radius-box/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', '[data-theme="gf-dark"] {\n --gf-radius-box: 1rem;'), tokens), /dark\/radius-box/)
+})
+
+test('missing and extra keys or themes fail; deleting a mirror key cannot bypass checks', () => {
+  const missing = structuredClone(tokens)
+  delete missing.dark['color-primary']
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, missing), /dark\/color-primary/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', ''), tokens), /depth/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', '--gf-depth: 1; --gf-new-token: 2px;'), tokens), /new-token/)
+  const extra = structuredClone(tokens)
+  extra.light['extra-token'] = 1
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, extra), /extra-token/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, { light: tokens.light }), /themes/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, { ...tokens, other: {} }), /themes/)
+})
+
+test('web-only course and typography tokens do not become mobile component roles', () => {
+  checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-text-xs: 0.6875rem', '--gf-text-xs: 1rem').replace('--gf-color-course-1: oklch(45% 0.19 268)', '--gf-color-course-1: #123456'), tokens)
+})
+
+test('missing theme blocks and duplicate declarations fail closed', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"]', '[data-theme="other"]'), tokens), /theme/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', '--gf-depth: 1; --gf-depth: 2;'), tokens), /Duplicate/)
+})
+
+test('selector broadening and conditional theme rules cannot masquerade as global parity', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', ':root,\n[data-theme="gf-dark"] {'), tokens), /selector/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-light"] {', '[data-theme="gf-light"], body {'), tokens), /selector/)
+  const nested = css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', '@media print {\n[data-theme="gf-dark"] {').replace('\n@theme inline', '\n}\n@theme inline')
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(nested, tokens), /nested|Unsupported/)
+})
+
+test('dark overrides must follow root defaults in source order', () => {
+  const blocks = css.match(/[^{}]+\{[^{}]*\}/g)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror([blocks[1], blocks[0], ...blocks.slice(2)].join('\n'), tokens), /order/)
+})
+
+test('Tailwind alias block cannot redefine the source token values', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('@theme inline {', '@theme inline {\n --gf-depth: 2;'), tokens), /selector/)
+})

+    `Twemoji ${version}: ${files.length} PNGs, ${entries.length} mapped sequences${checkOnly ? ' (checked)' : ''}`,
+  )
+}
+
+// Node 24 identifies the entry module after resolving filesystem aliases.
+if (import.meta.main) {
+  await main()
+}

evidence.title: apps/mobile/packages/ui_kit/tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.test.mjs
evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/mobile/packages/ui_kit/tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.test.mjs b/apps/mobile/packages/ui_kit/tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.test.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..aee906317
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/mobile/packages/ui_kit/tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.test.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,116 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import path from 'node:path'
+import test from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import {
+  buildTwemojiManifest,
+  parseDefaultTextPresentationCodepoints,
+} from './generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'
+
+const toolDir = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
+const packageDir = path.resolve(toolDir, '..')
+const unicodeDataPath = path.join(toolDir, 'data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+const flagAssetPath = path.join(
+  packageDir,
+  'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72/1f1f9-1f1fc.png',
+)
+
+test('Unicode 17 text-presentation defaults include copyright, registered, and trademark', () => {
+  const codepoints = parseDefaultTextPresentationCodepoints(
+    readFileSync(unicodeDataPath, 'utf8'),
+  )
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x00a9))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x00ae))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x2122))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x2764))
+  assert.ok(!codepoints.includes(0x1f600))
+})
+
+test('manifest generation omits the excluded Taiwan flag but retains other flags', () => {
+  const { entries, excludedSequences } = buildTwemojiManifest([
+    '1f1f9-1f1fc.png',
+    '1f1fa-1f1f8.png',
+    '1f600.png',
+    'e000.png',
+    'not-an-asset.txt',
+  ])
+  const sequences = new Set(entries.map(({ sequence }) => sequence))
+  assert.ok(!sequences.has('🇹🇼'))
+  assert.deepEqual(excludedSequences, ['🇹🇼'])
+  assert.ok(sequences.has('🇺🇸'))
+  assert.ok(sequences.has('😀'))
+})
+
+test('checked-in manifest and Dart map are reproducible and the flag file is absent', () => {
+  execFileSync(
+    process.execPath,
+    [path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), '--check'],
+    { cwd: packageDir, stdio: 'pipe' },
+  )
+  assert.equal(existsSync(flagAssetPath), false)
+
+  const manifest = JSON.parse(
+    readFileSync(path.join(packageDir, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json'), 'utf8'),
+  )
+  assert.equal(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '🇹🇼'), false)
+  assert.deepEqual(manifest.excludedSequences, ['🇹🇼'])
+  assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '🇺🇸'))
+  assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '😀'))
+})
+
+for (const target of ['manifest', 'Dart map', 'asset list', 'Unicode defaults']) {
+  test(`--check rejects stale ${target} without rewriting either generated output`, () => {
+    const fixture = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'twemoji-freshness-'))
+    try {
+      const tool = path.join(fixture, 'tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs')
+      const data = path.join(fixture, 'tool/data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+      const images = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72')
+      const manifest = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json')
+      const dart = path.join(fixture, 'lib/src/twemoji/twemoji_asset_map.g.dart')
+      mkdirSync(path.dirname(data), { recursive: true })
+      mkdirSync(images, { recursive: true })
+      copyFileSync(path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), tool)
+      writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n')
+      // The manifest generator consumes inventory names, not PNG pixel contents.
+      writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f600.png'), '')
+      execFileSync(process.execPath, [tool], { stdio: 'pipe' })
+      if (target === 'manifest') writeFileSync(manifest, '{}\n')
+      if (target === 'Dart map') writeFileSync(dart, '// stale\n')
+      if (target === 'asset list') writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f601.png'), '')
+      if (target === 'Unicode defaults') writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n00ae\n')
+      const before = [readFileSync(manifest, 'utf8'), readFileSync(dart, 'utf8')]
+      assert.throws(
+        () => execFileSync(process.execPath, [tool, '--check'], { stdio: 'pipe' }),
+        (error) => error.status !== 0 && /is stale; regenerate it/.test(error.stderr.toString()),
+      )
+      assert.deepEqual([readFileSync(manifest, 'utf8'), readFileSync(dart, 'utf8')], before)
+    } finally {
+      rmSync(fixture, { recursive: true, force: true })
+    }
+  })
+}
+
+test('CLI invoked through a file alias generates the canonical package outputs', () => {
+  const fixture = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'twemoji-alias-'))
+  try {
+    const tool = path.join(fixture, 'tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs')
+    const alias = path.join(fixture, 'tool/alias.mjs')
+    const data = path.join(fixture, 'tool/data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+    const images = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72')
+    mkdirSync(path.dirname(data), { recursive: true })
+    mkdirSync(images, { recursive: true })
+    copyFileSync(path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), tool)
+    writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n')
+    writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f600.png'), '')
+    symlinkSync(tool, alias)
+    execFileSync(process.execPath, [alias], { stdio: 'pipe' })
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json'), 'utf8'))
+    assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '😀'))
+    assert.ok(existsSync(path.join(fixture, 'lib/src/twemoji/twemoji_asset_map.g.dart')))
+  } finally {
+    rmSync(fixture, { recursive: true, force: true })
+  }
+})

evidence.title: apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh b/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
index 7a4e076d4..e8b737ad0 100755
--- a/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
+++ b/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
@@ -3,19 +3,34 @@ set -euo pipefail
 
 # Build a physical-device debug APK against the shared dev backend.
 # Keep the endpoint in build-time defines so local emulator/test defaults stay local.
 SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"
 FORUM_APP_DIR="$SCRIPT_ROOT/apps/mobile/packages/forum_app"
-DEV_API_URL="${YOURTJ_DEV_API_URL:-https://dev.yourtj.de}"
-DEV_OIDC_ISSUER="${YOURTJ_DEV_OIDC_ISSUER:-$DEV_API_URL/api/oauth}"
+DEV_API_URL="https://dev.yourtj.de"
+DEV_OIDC_ISSUER="$DEV_API_URL/api/oauth"
 DEV_CLIENT_ID="${YOURTJ_DEV_CLIENT_ID:-yourtj-mobile}"
 
 cd "$FORUM_APP_DIR"
+shopt -s nullglob
+# A successful command must not make a previous build look like a new APK.
+previous_apks=(build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk)
+if ((${#previous_apks[@]} > 0)); then
+  rm -f -- "${previous_apks[@]}"
+fi
 flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi \
+  --dart-define=YOURTJ_ENVIRONMENT=dev \
+  --dart-define=YOURTJ_PREVIEW=true \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_API_BASE_URL="$DEV_API_URL" \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_OIDC_ISSUER="$DEV_OIDC_ISSUER" \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_OIDC_CLIENT_ID="$DEV_CLIENT_ID"
 
+apks=(build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk)
+if ((${#apks[@]} == 0)); then
+  printf 'No split debug APKs found under %s/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk\n' \
+    "$FORUM_APP_DIR" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
 printf '\nDev APKs:\n'
-for apk in build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk; do
+for apk in "${apks[@]}"; do
   printf '  %s\n' "$FORUM_APP_DIR/$apk"
 done

+        .map(

+

@@ -52,10 +64,60 @@ class StickerRepository {

     '/api/forum/my-stickers-order',

     parser: (_) {},

+
+  /// Published market packs (issue #1429); browsing needs no account.
+  Future<StickerMarketPagePayload> market({

+
+  Future<StickerMarketPackDetailPayload> marketPack(int id) => _client.get(
+    '/api/forum/sticker-market/pack',

+  Future<List<StickerMarketPackPayload>> myPacks() => _client.get(

+          (e) => StickerMarketPackPayload.fromJson(

+
+  Future<StickerMarketPackPayload> savePack(int packId) => _client.post(

+    required this.targetEmail,

+    required this.state,
+    required this.remainingToday,

+        targetEmail: json['targetEmail'] as String,

@@ -2,10 +2,25 @@ import Flutter
 import UIKit
 import XCTest
 @testable import Runner
 
 class RunnerTests: XCTestCase {
+  func testAccountReturnRetainsOnlyTheFixedColdAndForegroundHint() {
+    let bridge = YourTJAccountReturnBridge()
+    XCTAssertFalse(bridge.handle(URL(string: "yourtj://callback?code=secret")!))
+    XCTAssertFalse(bridge.handle(URL(string: "yourtj://account/email-verified?token=secret")!))
+    XCTAssertTrue(bridge.handle(URL(string: YourTJAccountReturnBridge.link)!))
+    var received: [String] = []
+    XCTAssertNil(bridge.onListen(withArguments: nil) { if let value = $0 as? String { received.append(value) } })
+    XCTAssertEqual(received, [YourTJAccountReturnBridge.link])
+    XCTAssertTrue(bridge.handle(URL(string: YourTJAccountReturnBridge.link)!))
+    XCTAssertEqual(received.count, 2)
+    XCTAssertNil(bridge.onCancel(withArguments: nil))
+    XCTAssertTrue(bridge.handle(URL(string: YourTJAccountReturnBridge.link)!))
+    XCTAssertEqual(received.count, 2)
+  }
+
 
   func testPushPresentationSuppressesOnlyVisibleConversationAndWrongAccount() {
     let message: [AnyHashable: Any] = ["route": "/chat?userId=7&recipientId=9",
       "sourceKind": "chat_message", "sourceId": 12, "recipientId": 9]
     XCTAssertFalse(AppDelegate.shouldPresentPush(message, userID: 9, peerID: 7, foreground: true))

+import 'package:core/core.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
+import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../providers.dart';
+import '../../widgets/status_views.dart';
+import '../courses/course_common.dart';
+
+final campusCoursesProvider =
+    FutureProvider.autoDispose<CourseListResultPayload>(
+      (ref) => ref
+          .watch(courseRepositoryProvider)
+          .list(size: 3, onlyWithReviews: true),
+    );
+
+/// Public course recommendations shared by signed-in and guest landing views.
+class CampusCoursePicks extends ConsumerWidget {
+  const CampusCoursePicks({super.key});
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
+    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    return Column(
+      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+      children: [
+        GfText(
+          l.campusCoursesTitle,
+          style: GfTheme.typographyOf(context).title2,
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 12),
+        ref
+            .watch(campusCoursesProvider)
+            .when(
+              loading: () => const GfLoading(),
+              error: (_, _) => GfErrorRetry(
+                message: l.commonRetry,
+                onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(campusCoursesProvider),
+              ),
+              data: (result) => result.list.isEmpty
+                  ? GfEmpty(message: l.campusCoursesEmpty)
+                  : Column(
+                      children: [
+                        for (final course in result.list)
+                          ListTile(
+                            title: GfText(course.name),
+                            key: ValueKey('campus-course-${course.id}'),
+                            subtitle: GfText(
+                              '${courseTeacherLabel(course, CourseCopy(l))} · ${course.department}',
+                            ),
+                            trailing: GfText(
+                              course.ratingAvg?.toStringAsFixed(1) ?? '—',
+                            ),
+                            onTap: () => context.push('/courses/${course.id}'),
+                          ),
+                      ],
+                    ),
+            ),
+        TextButton(
+          onPressed: () => context.push('/courses'),
+          child: GfText(l.coursesTitle),
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}

+/// Freshness line folded into the timetable header.
+class CampusTimetableStatus {
+  const CampusTimetableStatus(this.text, {this.detail, this.warning = false});
+
+  /// One-line summary shown beside the dates.
+  final String text;
+
+  /// Full wording (snapshot time and any warning), shown on tap.
+  final String? detail;
+  final bool warning;
+}
+
+/// Header height for a given text scale; the grid takes the rest.
+double campusTimetableHeaderHeight(double scale) => (44 + 26) * scale + 8;
+
+/// Content wider than this shows the focused day's agenda beside the grid.
+const double kTimetableAgendaBreakpoint = 720;
+
+/// The campus week: a compact header (week switcher, freshness, options) and
+/// a grid that fits the given [height]. Secondary tools live in the options
+/// sheet so the timetable keeps the screen.
+class CampusWeekTimetable extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
+  const CampusWeekTimetable({
+    super.key,
+    required this.data,
+    required this.week,
+    required this.maxWeek,
+    required this.times,
+    this.selectedWeek,
+    this.onWeekChanged,
+    this.height,
+    this.status,
+    this.refreshing = false,
+    this.onRefresh,
+  });
+  final CampusDataset data;
+  final int week;
+  final int maxWeek;
+  final List<SectionTime> times;
+  final int? selectedWeek;
+  final ValueChanged<int>? onWeekChanged;
+
+  /// Height available to header and grid. Null keeps comfortable rows.
+  final double? height;
+  final CampusTimetableStatus? status;
+  final bool refreshing;
+  final VoidCallback? onRefresh;
+
+  @override
+  ConsumerState<CampusWeekTimetable> createState() =>
+      _CampusWeekTimetableState();
+}
+
+class _CampusWeekTimetableState extends ConsumerState<CampusWeekTimetable> {
+  late int week = (widget.selectedWeek ?? widget.week).clamp(1, widget.maxWeek);
+  int? _focusedDay;
+  bool _appliedFocusPref = false;
+
+  void _selectWeek(int value) {
+    setState(() => week = value.clamp(1, widget.maxWeek));
+    widget.onWeekChanged?.call(week);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void didUpdateWidget(CampusWeekTimetable oldWidget) {
+    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
+    week = (widget.selectedWeek ?? week).clamp(1, widget.maxWeek);
+  }
+
+  int get _today => campusNow(DateTime.now()).weekday;
+
+  Future<void> _pickWeek() async {
+    final busy = <int>{
+      for (final e in widget.data.events)
+        ...(e.weeks.isEmpty
+            ? [for (var w = 1; w <= widget.maxWeek; w++) w]
+            : e.weeks),
+      // Empty weeks repeat every week, like a course with no week filter.
+      for (final b in ref.read(timetableMemoProvider).blocks)
+        ...(b.weeks.isEmpty
+            ? [for (var w = 1; w <= widget.maxWeek; w++) w]
+            : b.weeks),
+    };
+    final picked = await showTimetableWeekPicker(
+      context,
+      week: week,
+      currentWeek: widget.week,
+      maxWeek: widget.maxWeek,
+      busyWeeks: busy,
+    );
+    if (picked != null && mounted) _selectWeek(picked);
+  }
+
+  void _openItem(TimetableItem item, List<SectionTime> times, int rows) {
+    switch (item.kind) {
+      case TimetableItemKind.block:
+        // Read first, like a course; editing is one deliberate tap away.
+        showTimetableBlockDetails(
+          context,
+          block: item.block!,
+          times: times,
+          onEdit: () => showTimetableBlockEditor(
+            context,
+            block: item.block,
+            week: week,
+            rows: rows,
+            maxWeek: widget.maxWeek,
+            times: times,
+          ),
+        );
+      case TimetableItemKind.course || TimetableItemKind.otherWeek:
+        final index = item.eventIndex;
+        if (index == null) return;
+        final shownWeek = week;
+        final ghost = item.kind == TimetableItemKind.otherWeek;
+        showGfBottomSheet<void>(
+          context,
+          keyboardAware: true,
+          builder: (_) => CampusPrivateSurface(
+            builder: (_) => CampusCourseDetails(
+              week: ghost ? null : shownWeek,
+              index: index,
+              noteWeek: ghost ? null : shownWeek,
+              times: times,
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+    }
+  }

+  /// The focused day (or today) at its first free pair of sections.
+  TimetableCellRange _defaultRange(TimetableWeekLayout layout) {
+    var day =
+        _focusedDay ??

+            ? _today

+    if (!layout.days.contains(day)) day = layout.days.first;

+        return TimetableCellRange(days: [day], start: s, end: s + 1);

+      _appliedFocusPref = true;
+      if (memo.prefs.focusToday) _focusedDay = _today;
+    }

+      events: widget.data.events,

+      blocks: memo.blocks,

+      layout.rows,

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+/// Match the catalog's canonical term to PK calendar labels. This follows the
+/// server's course.NormalizeTermLabel; unknown labels never match a term.
+String? canonicalPlannerTerm(String label) {
+  final match = RegExp(
+    r'(\d{4}-\d{4})[^0-9一二三四五六七八九十]*([0-9一二三四五六七八九十]+)[^0-9一二三四五六七八九十]*$',
+  ).firstMatch(label.trim());
+  if (match == null) return null;
+  final raw = match[2]!;
+  const digits = {
+    '一': 1,
+    '二': 2,
+    '三': 3,
+    '四': 4,
+    '五': 5,
+    '六': 6,
+    '七': 7,
+    '八': 8,
+    '九': 9,
+  };
+  final ordinal =
+      int.tryParse(raw) ??
+      digits[raw] ??
+      (raw == '十'
+          ? 10
+          : raw.startsWith('十') && raw.length == 2
+          ? 10 + (digits[raw[1]] ?? 0)
+          : raw.endsWith('十') && raw.length == 2
+          ? (digits[raw[0]] ?? 0) * 10
+          : raw.length == 3 &&
+                raw[1] == '十' &&
+                digits.containsKey(raw[0]) &&
+                digits.containsKey(raw[2])
+          ? digits[raw[0]]! * 10 + digits[raw[2]]!
+          : null);
+  return ordinal == null ? null : '${match[1]}-$ordinal';
+}

+import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../schedule/schedule_sync.dart';
+import 'schedule_sync_panel.dart';
+import 'schedule_storage_panel.dart';
+import 'scheduler_web_tip.dart';
+
+/// Collapse help and recovery controls while keeping actionable sync problems
+/// visible in the summary, including updates received after the page opens.
+class ScheduleStatusSummary extends ConsumerWidget {
+  const ScheduleStatusSummary({super.key});
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
+    final sync = ref.watch(scheduleSyncControllerProvider);
+    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    return ListenableBuilder(
+      listenable: Listenable.merge([
+        sync.conflicts,
+        sync.needsAdoption,
+        sync.blocked,
+        sync.drafts,
+      ]),
+      builder: (_, _) => ExpansionTile(
+        // ui_kit 暂无折叠面板组件；ExpansionTile 的标题/图标/分割线颜色
+        // 跟随 gfThemeData 的 ColorScheme 与 dividerColor（Gf token），刻意保留。
+        title: GfText(l.scheduleStatusHelp),
+        subtitle: sync.blocked.value
+            ? GfText(
+                sync.blockedReason.value == 'rejected'
+                    ? l.planSyncRejected
+                    : l.planSyncCapacity,
+              )
+            : sync.conflicts.value.isNotEmpty
+            ? GfText(l.planSyncTitle)
+            : sync.needsAdoption.value
+            ? GfText(l.planSyncAdoptHint)
+            : sync.drafts.value.isNotEmpty
+            ? GfText(l.planSyncDrafts)
+            : null,
+        children: const [
+          SchedulerWebTip(),
+          ScheduleSyncPanel(),
+          ScheduleStoragePanel(),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+import 'package:core/core.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../format.dart';
+import '../../asset_url.dart';
+import '../../widgets/markdown_view.dart';
+import '../../widgets/share/share_image_preview.dart';
+
+/// Share only the public author identity; viewer-local notes never enter PNGs.
+Future<void> showPostShareImage(
+  BuildContext context, {
+  required PostPayload post,
+  required String topicTitle,
+  required String baseUrl,
+  bool topicLink = false,
+}) async {
+  final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+  await showShareImagePreview(
+    context,
+    fileName: 'yourtj-post-${post.topicId}-${post.postNo}.png',
+    cardBuilder: (theme) {
+      final colors = theme.colors;
+      final postUrl = Uri.parse(baseUrl)
+          .replace(
+            path: topicLink
+                ? '/p/post/${post.topicId}'
+                : '/p/post/${post.topicId}/${post.postNo}',
+            query: null,
+            fragment: null,
+          )
+          .toString();
+      // Share cards mirror the reading view's author identity
+      // (anonymous label / nickname / username) so a post looks the same
+      // exported as it does in the app. They deliberately stay clear of
+      // privateDisplayName(): it bakes the viewer's local private notes
+      // into the label, which must never leak into an exported PNG.
+      final author = post.isAnonymous
+          ? l10n.courseCopyAuthorAnonymousLabel
+          : (post.author.nickname?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
+                ? post.author.nickname!.trim()
+                : post.author.username.trim().isNotEmpty
+                ? post.author.username.trim()
+                : l10n.courseCopyAuthorAnonymousLabel);
+      return ShareImageCard(
+        theme: theme,
+        child: Column(
+          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+          children: [
+            GfText(
+              topicTitle,
+              style: TextStyle(
+                color: colors.baseContent,
+                fontSize: 22,
+                height: 1.3,
+                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
+              ),
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            Row(
+              children: [
+                if (post.isAnonymous)
+                  CircleAvatar(
+                    radius: 18,
+                    backgroundColor: colors.base200,
+                    child: GfSymbol(
+                      'user-round',
+                      size: 18,
+                      color: colors.iconMuted,
+                    ),
+                  )
+                else
+                  ClipOval(
+                    child: ShareImageNetworkImage(
+                      resolveApiAssetUrl(post.author.avatarUrl),
+                      width: 36,
+                      height: 36,
+                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
+                      errorBuilder: (_) => CircleAvatar(
+                        radius: 18,
+                        backgroundColor: colors.base200,
+                        child: GfSymbol(
+                          'user-round',
+                          size: 18,
+                          color: colors.iconMuted,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                const SizedBox(width: 10),
+                Expanded(
+                  child: Column(
+                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                    children: [
+                      GfText(
+                        author,
+                        style: TextStyle(
+                          color: colors.baseContent,
+                          fontSize: 14,
+                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                      GfText(
+                        '#${post.postNo} · ${timeAgo(post.createdAt, l10n: l10n)}',
+                        style: TextStyle(color: colors.iconMuted, fontSize: 12),
+                      ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ],
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 16),
+            GfMarkdownView(
+              data: post.content,
+              mentions: post.mentions,
+              screenshot: true,
+              colors: colors,
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            GfText(
+              postUrl,
+              style: TextStyle(color: colors.primary, fontSize: 11),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      );
+    },
+  );
+}

+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+
+/// Topic controls inside a verified native side pocket. The caller owns its
+/// placement; short pockets scroll instead of reducing the 48px touch targets.
+class TopicSideActions extends StatelessWidget {
+  const TopicSideActions({
+    super.key,
+    required this.onBack,
+    required this.actions,
+    required this.currentNo,
+    required this.maxNo,
+    required this.onFloorTap,
+    required this.onOpenReply,
+  });
+
+  final VoidCallback onBack;
+  final List<GfTopicAction> actions;
+  final int currentNo;
+  final int? maxNo;
+  final VoidCallback? onFloorTap;
+  final VoidCallback? onOpenReply;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    return Padding(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
+      child: Align(
+        alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
+        child: SizedBox(
+          key: const Key('topic-action-rail'),
+          width: 56,
+          child: Stack(
+            children: [
+              const Positioned.fill(
+                child: GfNavigationSurface(
+                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(28)),
+                ),
+              ),
+              Material(
+                type: MaterialType.transparency,
+                child: ClipRRect(
+                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
+                  child: ListView(
+                    shrinkWrap: true,
+                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
+                      horizontal: 4,
+                      vertical: 8,
+                    ),
+                    children: [
+                      GfIconButton(
+                        symbol: 'chevron-left',
+                        tooltip: l10n.commonBack,
+                        size: 48,
+                        onPressed: onBack,
+                      ),
+                      if (maxNo != null) ...[
+                        Padding(
+                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
+                            horizontal: 10,
+                            vertical: 6,
+                          ),
+                          child: GfDivider(color: colors.separator),
+                        ),
+                        GfIconButton(
+                          symbol: 'list-ordered',
+                          tooltip:
+                              '${l10n.topicJumpToFloor} · $currentNo / $maxNo',
+                          size: 48,
+                          onPressed: onFloorTap,
+                        ),
+                      ],
+                      for (final action in actions)
+                        GfActionFeedback(
+                          active: action.active,
+                          onPressed: action.onTap,
+                          child: GfSymbol(
+                            action.symbol,
+                            color: action.active
+                                ? action.activeColor
+                                : colors.iconMuted,
+                          ),
+                          builder: (activate, visual) => Semantics(
+                            label: action.title,
+                            button: true,
+                            enabled: true,
+                            toggled: action.active,
+                            onTap: activate,
+                            excludeSemantics: true,
+                            child: Tooltip(
+                              message: action.title ?? '',
+                              excludeFromSemantics: true,
+                              child: SizedBox.square(
+                                dimension: 48,
+                                child: TextButton(
+                                  onPressed: activate,
+                                  style: TextButton.styleFrom(
+                                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
+                                    shape: const CircleBorder(),
+                                  ),
+                                  child: visual,
+                                ),
+                              ),
+                            ),
+                          ),
+                        ),
+                      if (onOpenReply != null)
+                        GfIconButton(
+                          symbol: 'comment-plus',
+                          tooltip: l10n.topicJoinDiscussion,
+                          size: 48,
+                          color: colors.primary,
+                          onPressed: onOpenReply,
+                        ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+/// Dims the page and, on glass, frosts it, so the menu's glass reads against
+/// a softened backdrop instead of busy content.
+class _FrostedScrim extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _FrostedScrim({required this.animation});
+
+  final Animation<double> animation;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final glass = GfNavigationSurface.usesGlass(context);
+    return IgnorePointer(
+      child: AnimatedBuilder(
+        animation: animation,
+        builder: (context, _) {
+          final t = animation.value;
+          final dim = ColoredBox(
+            color: glass
+                // The frost already separates the menu; dim less than a sheet.
+                ? Colors.black.withValues(
+                    alpha: (colors.isDark ? 0.5 : 0.2) * t,
+                  )
+                : colors.scrim.withValues(alpha: colors.scrim.a * t),
+            child: const SizedBox.expand(),
+          );
+          if (!glass || t == 0) return dim;
+          return BackdropFilter(
+            filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 8 * t, sigmaY: 8 * t),
+            child: dim,
+          );
+        },
+      ),
+    );
+  }

+/// The 56-pixel title row, taller by [stretch] while a pull stretches it.
+class _StretchingTitleRow extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _StretchingTitleRow({required this.stretch, required this.child});
+
+  final ValueListenable<double>? stretch;
+  final Widget child;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final listenable = stretch;
+    if (listenable == null) return SizedBox(height: 56, child: child);
+    return ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
+      valueListenable: listenable,
+      child: child,
+      builder: (context, extra, child) =>
+          SizedBox(height: 56 + math.max(0, extra), child: child),
+    );
+  }
+}
+

+
+/// Moves page content down by [shift] without relayout.

+  const _Shifted({required this.shift, required this.child});
+

+  final Widget child;
+

+        child: child,

+}

+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

+void main() {
+  test('dev config requires the preview flag and official dev endpoints', () {
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: true,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      returnsNormally,
+    );
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: false,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: true,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://example.com',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://example.com/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('production config cannot connect to the dev API', () {
+    expect(
+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'production',
+        preview: false,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );
+  });

+    'list',
+    (_) => const ListsPage(),

+  GalleryPage(
+    'overlays',
+    '浮层',
+    '对话框 · 底部面板 · 菜单 · 操作表',
+    'layers-filled',
+    (_) => const OverlaysPage(),
+  ),
+  GalleryPage(
+    'content',
+    '内容',

+final List<GalleryPage> screenPages = [

+        darkTheme: gfThemeData(Brightness.dark),
+        themeMode: mode,
+        home: _launchHome() ?? const GalleryIndex(),
+        onGenerateRoute: _route,
+        builder: (context, child) {
+          final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
+          return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
+            value: dark
+                ? SystemUiOverlayStyle.light
+                : SystemUiOverlayStyle.dark,
+            child: child!,
+          );
+        },
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  Widget? _launchHome() {
+    final id = galleryLaunchPage;
+    if (id == null) return null;
+    final page = [...catalogPages, ...screenPages].where((p) => p.id == id);
+    return page.isEmpty ? null : Builder(builder: page.first.build);
+  }
+
+  Route<dynamic>? _route(RouteSettings settings) {
+    final uri = Uri.tryParse(settings.name ?? '');
+    if (uri == null) return null;
+    final segments = uri.pathSegments;
+    if (segments.isEmpty) return null;
+    final id = segments.last;
+    galleryInitialScroll = double.tryParse(uri.queryParameters['y'] ?? '') ?? 0;
+    final theme = uri.queryParameters['theme'];
+    if (theme != null) {

+          ? ThemeMode.dark
+          : ThemeMode.light;
+    }
+    final page = [...catalogPages, ...screenPages].where((p) => p.id == id);
+    if (page.isEmpty) return null;
+    return MaterialPageRoute(builder: page.first.build, settings: settings);
+  }

+        children: [
+          GfListSection(
+            header: '组件',
+            dividerIndent: GfSpace.lg + 32 + GfSpace.md,
+            children: [for (final page in catalogPages) row(page)],
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: GfSpace.section),
+          GfListSection(
+            header: '示例页面',
+            footer: '示例页面只组合组件库，不含业务逻辑与网络请求以外的数据。',
+            dividerIndent: GfSpace.lg + 32 + GfSpace.md,
+            children: [for (final page in screenPages) row(page)],
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import test from 'node:test'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { checkTokenMirror, normalizeTokenValue } from './check_token_mirror.mjs'
+
+const cssPath = new URL('../../../../gooseforum/resource/src/styles/tokens.css', import.meta.url)
+const tokenPath = new URL('../lib/src/theme/tokens.json', import.meta.url)
+const css = readFileSync(cssPath, 'utf8')
+const tokens = JSON.parse(readFileSync(tokenPath, 'utf8'))
+
+// Known sRGB references, not values calculated by the implementation under test.
+test('normalizes the supported CSS values into the existing mobile representation', () => {
+  for (const [value, expected] of [
+    ['#ABCDEF', '#abcdef'], ['oklch(100% 0 0)', '#ffffff'],
+    ['oklch(0 0 0)', '#000000'], ['oklch(50% 0 0)', '#636363'],
+    ['oklch(54.6% 0.215 262.88)', '#2563eb'],
+    ['oklch(62.7% 0.194 149.214)', '#00a63e'],
+  ]) assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('color-primary', value), expected)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('radius-box', '0.5rem'), 8)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('border', '1px'), 1)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('depth', '1'), 1)
+})
+
+test('unsupported or invalid values fail rather than silently skipping equality', () => {
+  for (const value of ['red', '#fff', 'var(--other)', 'oklch(50% 0.1 0 / .5)', 'oklch(101% 0 0)', 'oklch(50% -1 0)']) {
+    assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('color-primary', value), /Unsupported/)
+  }
+  for (const value of ['calc(1rem)', '1em', 'NaN', '1px junk', '8']) {
+    assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('radius-box', value), /Unsupported/)
+  }
+  assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('depth', '1px'), /Unsupported/)
+})
+
+test('checked-in mirror equals both resolved web themes and CLI works outside the repository', () => {
+  checkTokenMirror(css, tokens)
+  const output = execFileSync(process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(new URL('check_token_mirror.mjs', import.meta.url))], { cwd: tmpdir(), encoding: 'utf8' })
+  assert.match(output, /Token mirror: light and dark values match/)
+})
+
+for (const theme of ['light', 'dark']) {
+  for (const key of ['color-primary', 'color-tooltip-bg', 'radius-box', 'depth']) {
+    test(`detects a changed mobile value: ${theme}/${key}`, () => {
+      const changed = structuredClone(tokens)
+      changed[theme][key] = key.startsWith('color-') ? '#ffffff' : 9
+      assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, changed), new RegExp(`${theme}/${key}`))
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+test('detects a web-only change without changing the mobile mirror', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('oklch(54.6% 0.215 262.88)', '#ffffff'), tokens), /light\/color-primary/)
+})
+
+test('dark inherits root geometry and static colors, but explicit overrides win', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-radius-box: 0.5rem', '--gf-radius-box: 1rem'), tokens), /light\/radius-box[\s\S]*dark\/radius-box/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', '[data-theme="gf-dark"] {\n --gf-radius-box: 1rem;'), tokens), /dark\/radius-box/)
+})
+
+test('missing and extra keys or themes fail; deleting a mirror key cannot bypass checks', () => {
+  const missing = structuredClone(tokens)
+  delete missing.dark['color-primary']
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, missing), /dark\/color-primary/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', ''), tokens), /depth/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', '--gf-depth: 1; --gf-new-token: 2px;'), tokens), /new-token/)
+  const extra = structuredClone(tokens)
+  extra.light['extra-token'] = 1
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, extra), /extra-token/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, { light: tokens.light }), /themes/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, { ...tokens, other: {} }), /themes/)
+})
+
+test('web-only course and typography tokens do not become mobile component roles', () => {
+  checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-text-xs: 0.6875rem', '--gf-text-xs: 1rem').replace('--gf-color-course-1: oklch(45% 0.19 268)', '--gf-color-course-1: #123456'), tokens)
+})
+
+test('missing theme blocks and duplicate declarations fail closed', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"]', '[data-theme="other"]'), tokens), /theme/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', '--gf-depth: 1; --gf-depth: 2;'), tokens), /Duplicate/)
+})
+
+test('selector broadening and conditional theme rules cannot masquerade as global parity', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', ':root,\n[data-theme="gf-dark"] {'), tokens), /selector/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-light"] {', '[data-theme="gf-light"], body {'), tokens), /selector/)
+  const nested = css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', '@media print {\n[data-theme="gf-dark"] {').replace('\n@theme inline', '\n}\n@theme inline')
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(nested, tokens), /nested|Unsupported/)
+})
+
+test('dark overrides must follow root defaults in source order', () => {
+  const blocks = css.match(/[^{}]+\{[^{}]*\}/g)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror([blocks[1], blocks[0], ...blocks.slice(2)].join('\n'), tokens), /order/)
+})
+
+test('Tailwind alias block cannot redefine the source token values', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('@theme inline {', '@theme inline {\n --gf-depth: 2;'), tokens), /selector/)
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import path from 'node:path'
+import test from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import {
+  buildTwemojiManifest,
+  parseDefaultTextPresentationCodepoints,
+} from './generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'
+
+const toolDir = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
+const packageDir = path.resolve(toolDir, '..')
+const unicodeDataPath = path.join(toolDir, 'data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+const flagAssetPath = path.join(
+  packageDir,
+  'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72/1f1f9-1f1fc.png',
+)
+
+test('Unicode 17 text-presentation defaults include copyright, registered, and trademark', () => {
+  const codepoints = parseDefaultTextPresentationCodepoints(
+    readFileSync(unicodeDataPath, 'utf8'),
+  )
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x00a9))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x00ae))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x2122))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x2764))
+  assert.ok(!codepoints.includes(0x1f600))
+})
+
+test('manifest generation omits the excluded Taiwan flag but retains other flags', () => {
+  const { entries, excludedSequences } = buildTwemojiManifest([
+    '1f1f9-1f1fc.png',
+    '1f1fa-1f1f8.png',
+    '1f600.png',
+    'e000.png',
+    'not-an-asset.txt',
+  ])
+  const sequences = new Set(entries.map(({ sequence }) => sequence))
+  assert.ok(!sequences.has('🇹🇼'))
+  assert.deepEqual(excludedSequences, ['🇹🇼'])
+  assert.ok(sequences.has('🇺🇸'))
+  assert.ok(sequences.has('😀'))
+})
+
+test('checked-in manifest and Dart map are reproducible and the flag file is absent', () => {
+  execFileSync(
+    process.execPath,
+    [path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), '--check'],
+    { cwd: packageDir, stdio: 'pipe' },
+  )
+  assert.equal(existsSync(flagAssetPath), false)
+
+  const manifest = JSON.parse(
+    readFileSync(path.join(packageDir, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json'), 'utf8'),
+  )
+  assert.equal(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '🇹🇼'), false)
+  assert.deepEqual(manifest.excludedSequences, ['🇹🇼'])
+  assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '🇺🇸'))
+  assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '😀'))
+})
+
+for (const target of ['manifest', 'Dart map', 'asset list', 'Unicode defaults']) {
+  test(`--check rejects stale ${target} without rewriting either generated output`, () => {
+    const fixture = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'twemoji-freshness-'))
+    try {
+      const tool = path.join(fixture, 'tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs')
+      const data = path.join(fixture, 'tool/data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+      const images = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72')
+      const manifest = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json')
+      const dart = path.join(fixture, 'lib/src/twemoji/twemoji_asset_map.g.dart')
+      mkdirSync(path.dirname(data), { recursive: true })
+      mkdirSync(images, { recursive: true })
+      copyFileSync(path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), tool)
+      writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n')
+      // The manifest generator consumes inventory names, not PNG pixel contents.
+      writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f600.png'), '')
+      execFileSync(process.execPath, [tool], { stdio: 'pipe' })
+      if (target === 'manifest') writeFileSync(manifest, '{}\n')
+      if (target === 'Dart map') writeFileSync(dart, '// stale\n')
+      if (target === 'asset list') writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f601.png'), '')
+      if (target === 'Unicode defaults') writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n00ae\n')
+      const before = [readFileSync(manifest, 'utf8'), readFileSync(dart, 'utf8')]
+      assert.throws(
+        () => execFileSync(process.execPath, [tool, '--check'], { stdio: 'pipe' }),
+        (error) => error.status !== 0 && /is stale; regenerate it/.test(error.stderr.toString()),
+      )
+      assert.deepEqual([readFileSync(manifest, 'utf8'), readFileSync(dart, 'utf8')], before)
+    } finally {
+      rmSync(fixture, { recursive: true, force: true })
+    }
+  })
+}
+
+test('CLI invoked through a file alias generates the canonical package outputs', () => {
+  const fixture = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'twemoji-alias-'))
+  try {
+    const tool = path.join(fixture, 'tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs')
+    const alias = path.join(fixture, 'tool/alias.mjs')
+    const data = path.join(fixture, 'tool/data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+    const images = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72')
+    mkdirSync(path.dirname(data), { recursive: true })
+    mkdirSync(images, { recursive: true })
+    copyFileSync(path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), tool)
+    writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n')
+    writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f600.png'), '')
+    symlinkSync(tool, alias)
+    execFileSync(process.execPath, [alias], { stdio: 'pipe' })
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json'), 'utf8'))
+    assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '😀'))
+    assert.ok(existsSync(path.join(fixture, 'lib/src/twemoji/twemoji_asset_map.g.dart')))
+  } finally {
+    rmSync(fixture, { recursive: true, force: true })
+  }
+})

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh b/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
index 7a4e076d4..e8b737ad0 100755
--- a/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
+++ b/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
@@ -3,19 +3,34 @@ set -euo pipefail
 
 # Build a physical-device debug APK against the shared dev backend.
 # Keep the endpoint in build-time defines so local emulator/test defaults stay local.
 SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"
 FORUM_APP_DIR="$SCRIPT_ROOT/apps/mobile/packages/forum_app"
-DEV_API_URL="${YOURTJ_DEV_API_URL:-https://dev.yourtj.de}"
-DEV_OIDC_ISSUER="${YOURTJ_DEV_OIDC_ISSUER:-$DEV_API_URL/api/oauth}"
+DEV_API_URL="https://dev.yourtj.de"
+DEV_OIDC_ISSUER="$DEV_API_URL/api/oauth"
 DEV_CLIENT_ID="${YOURTJ_DEV_CLIENT_ID:-yourtj-mobile}"
 
 cd "$FORUM_APP_DIR"
+shopt -s nullglob
+# A successful command must not make a previous build look like a new APK.
+previous_apks=(build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk)
+if ((${#previous_apks[@]} > 0)); then
+  rm -f -- "${previous_apks[@]}"
+fi
 flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi \
+  --dart-define=YOURTJ_ENVIRONMENT=dev \
+  --dart-define=YOURTJ_PREVIEW=true \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_API_BASE_URL="$DEV_API_URL" \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_OIDC_ISSUER="$DEV_OIDC_ISSUER" \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_OIDC_CLIENT_ID="$DEV_CLIENT_ID"
 
+apks=(build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk)
+if ((${#apks[@]} == 0)); then
+  printf 'No split debug APKs found under %s/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk\n' \
+    "$FORUM_APP_DIR" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
 printf '\nDev APKs:\n'
-for apk in build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk; do
+for apk in "${apks[@]}"; do
   printf '  %s\n' "$FORUM_APP_DIR/$apk"
 done

+import 'package:core/core.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
+import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
+import 'package:ui_kit/ui_kit.dart';
+import '../../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../providers.dart';
+import '../../widgets/status_views.dart';
+import '../courses/course_common.dart';
+
+final campusCoursesProvider =
+    FutureProvider.autoDispose<CourseListResultPayload>(
+      (ref) => ref
+          .watch(courseRepositoryProvider)
+          .list(size: 3, onlyWithReviews: true),
+    );
+
+/// Public course recommendations shared by signed-in and guest landing views.
+class CampusCoursePicks extends ConsumerWidget {
+  const CampusCoursePicks({super.key});
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
+    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+    return Column(
+      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+      children: [
+        GfText(
+          l.campusCoursesTitle,
+          style: GfTheme.typographyOf(context).title2,
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 12),
+        ref
+            .watch(campusCoursesProvider)
+            .when(
+              loading: () => const GfLoading(),
+              error: (_, _) => GfErrorRetry(
+                message: l.commonRetry,
+                onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(campusCoursesProvider),
+              ),
+              data: (result) => result.list.isEmpty
+                  ? GfEmpty(message: l.campusCoursesEmpty)
+                  : Column(
+                      children: [
+                        for (final course in result.list)
+                          ListTile(
+                            title: GfText(course.name),
+                            key: ValueKey('campus-course-${course.id}'),
+                            subtitle: GfText(
+                              '${courseTeacherLabel(course, CourseCopy(l))} · ${course.department}',
+                            ),
+                            trailing: GfText(
+                              course.ratingAvg?.toStringAsFixed(1) ?? '—',
+                            ),
+                            onTap: () => context.push('/courses/${course.id}'),
+                          ),
+                      ],
+                    ),
+            ),
+        TextButton(
+          onPressed: () => context.push('/courses'),
+          child: GfText(l.coursesTitle),
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}

+
+/// Freshness line folded into the timetable header.
+class CampusTimetableStatus {
+  const CampusTimetableStatus(this.text, {this.detail, this.warning = false});
+
+  /// One-line summary shown beside the dates.
+  final String text;
+
+  /// Full wording (snapshot time and any warning), shown on tap.
+  final String? detail;
+  final bool warning;
+}
+
+/// Header height for a given text scale; the grid takes the rest.
+double campusTimetableHeaderHeight(double scale) => (44 + 26) * scale + 8;
+
+/// Content wider than this shows the focused day's agenda beside the grid.
+const double kTimetableAgendaBreakpoint = 720;
+
+/// The campus week: a compact header (week switcher, freshness, options) and
+/// a grid that fits the given [height]. Secondary tools live in the options
+/// sheet so the timetable keeps the screen.
+class CampusWeekTimetable extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
+  const CampusWeekTimetable({
+    super.key,
+    required this.data,
+    required this.week,
+    required this.maxWeek,
+    required this.times,
+    this.selectedWeek,
+    this.onWeekChanged,
+    this.height,
+    this.status,
+    this.refreshing = false,
+    this.onRefresh,
+  });
+  final CampusDataset data;
+  final int week;
+  final int maxWeek;
+  final List<SectionTime> times;
+  final int? selectedWeek;
+  final ValueChanged<int>? onWeekChanged;
+
+  /// Height available to header and grid. Null keeps comfortable rows.
+  final double? height;
+  final CampusTimetableStatus? status;
+  final bool refreshing;
+  final VoidCallback? onRefresh;
+
+  @override
+  ConsumerState<CampusWeekTimetable> createState() =>
+      _CampusWeekTimetableState();
+}
+
+class _CampusWeekTimetableState extends ConsumerState<CampusWeekTimetable> {
+  late int week = (widget.selectedWeek ?? widget.week).clamp(1, widget.maxWeek);
+  int? _focusedDay;
+  bool _appliedFocusPref = false;
+
+  void _selectWeek(int value) {
+    setState(() => week = value.clamp(1, widget.maxWeek));
+    widget.onWeekChanged?.call(week);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void didUpdateWidget(CampusWeekTimetable oldWidget) {
+    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
+    week = (widget.selectedWeek ?? week).clamp(1, widget.maxWeek);
+  }
+
+  int get _today => campusNow(DateTime.now()).weekday;
+
+  Future<void> _pickWeek() async {
+    final busy = <int>{
+      for (final e in widget.data.events)
+        ...(e.weeks.isEmpty
+            ? [for (var w = 1; w <= widget.maxWeek; w++) w]
+            : e.weeks),
+      // Empty weeks repeat every week, like a course with no week filter.
+      for (final b in ref.read(timetableMemoProvider).blocks)
+        ...(b.weeks.isEmpty
+            ? [for (var w = 1; w <= widget.maxWeek; w++) w]
+            : b.weeks),
+    };
+    final picked = await showTimetableWeekPicker(
+      context,
+      week: week,
+      currentWeek: widget.week,
+      maxWeek: widget.maxWeek,
+      busyWeeks: busy,
+    );
+    if (picked != null && mounted) _selectWeek(picked);
+  }
+
+  void _openItem(TimetableItem item, List<SectionTime> times, int rows) {
+    switch (item.kind) {
+      case TimetableItemKind.block:
+        // Read first, like a course; editing is one deliberate tap away.
+        showTimetableBlockDetails(
+          context,
+          block: item.block!,
+          times: times,
+          onEdit: () => showTimetableBlockEditor(
+            context,
+            block: item.block,
+            week: week,
+            rows: rows,
+            maxWeek: widget.maxWeek,
+            times: times,
+          ),
+        );
+      case TimetableItemKind.course || TimetableItemKind.otherWeek:
+        final index = item.eventIndex;
+        if (index == null) return;
+        final shownWeek = week;
+        final ghost = item.kind == TimetableItemKind.otherWeek;
+        showGfBottomSheet<void>(
+          context,
+          keyboardAware: true,
+          builder: (_) => CampusPrivateSurface(
+            builder: (_) => CampusCourseDetails(
+              week: ghost ? null : shownWeek,
+              index: index,
+              noteWeek: ghost ? null : shownWeek,
+              times: times,
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+    }
+  }

+  /// The focused day (or today) at its first free pair of sections.

+      if (memo.prefs.focusToday) _focusedDay = _today;

+          children: [

+                week: week,
+                maxWeek: widget.maxWeek,
+                isCurrent: isCurrent,
+                range: l.timetableDateRange(

+                  DateFormat.MMMd(l.localeName).format(dates.last),

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+/// Match the catalog's canonical term to PK calendar labels. This follows the
+/// server's course.NormalizeTermLabel; unknown labels never match a term.
+String? canonicalPlannerTerm(String label) {
+  final match = RegExp(
+    r'(\d{4}-\d{4})[^0-9一二三四五六七八九十]*([0-9一二三四五六七八九十]+)[^0-9一二三四五六七八九十]*$',
+  ).firstMatch(label.trim());
+  if (match == null) return null;
+  final raw = match[2]!;
+  const digits = {
+    '一': 1,
+    '二': 2,
+    '三': 3,
+    '四': 4,
+    '五': 5,
+    '六': 6,
+    '七': 7,
+    '八': 8,
+    '九': 9,
+  };
+  final ordinal =
+      int.tryParse(raw) ??
+      digits[raw] ??
+      (raw == '十'
+          ? 10
+          : raw.startsWith('十') && raw.length == 2
+          ? 10 + (digits[raw[1]] ?? 0)
+          : raw.endsWith('十') && raw.length == 2
+          ? (digits[raw[0]] ?? 0) * 10
+          : raw.length == 3 &&
+                raw[1] == '十' &&
+                digits.containsKey(raw[0]) &&
+                digits.containsKey(raw[2])
+          ? digits[raw[0]]! * 10 + digits[raw[2]]!
+          : null);
+  return ordinal == null ? null : '${match[1]}-$ordinal';
+}
