+
+/// Share only the public author identity; viewer-local notes never enter PNGs.
+Future<void> showPostShareImage(
+  BuildContext context, {
+  required PostPayload post,
+  required String topicTitle,
+  required String baseUrl,
+  bool topicLink = false,
+}) async {
+  final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
+  await showShareImagePreview(
+    context,
+    fileName: 'yourtj-post-${post.topicId}-${post.postNo}.png',
+    cardBuilder: (theme) {
+      final colors = theme.colors;
+      final postUrl = Uri.parse(baseUrl)
+          .replace(
+            path: topicLink
+                ? '/p/post/${post.topicId}'
+                : '/p/post/${post.topicId}/${post.postNo}',
+            query: null,
+            fragment: null,
+          )
+          .toString();
+      // Share cards mirror the reading view's author identity
+      // (anonymous label / nickname / username) so a post looks the same
+      // exported as it does in the app. They deliberately stay clear of
+      // privateDisplayName(): it bakes the viewer's local private notes
+      // into the label, which must never leak into an exported PNG.
+      final author = post.isAnonymous
+          ? l10n.courseCopyAuthorAnonymousLabel
+          : (post.author.nickname?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
+                ? post.author.nickname!.trim()
+                : post.author.username.trim().isNotEmpty
+                ? post.author.username.trim()
+                : l10n.courseCopyAuthorAnonymousLabel);
+      return ShareImageCard(
+        theme: theme,
+        child: Column(
+          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+          children: [
+            GfText(
+              topicTitle,
+              style: TextStyle(
+                color: colors.baseContent,
+                fontSize: 22,
+                height: 1.3,
+                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
+              ),
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            Row(
+              children: [
+                if (post.isAnonymous)
+                  CircleAvatar(
+                    radius: 18,
+                    backgroundColor: colors.base200,
+                    child: GfSymbol(
+                      'user-round',
+                      size: 18,
+                      color: colors.iconMuted,
+                    ),
+                  )
+                else
+                  ClipOval(
+                    child: ShareImageNetworkImage(
+                      resolveApiAssetUrl(post.author.avatarUrl),
+                      width: 36,
+                      height: 36,
+                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
+                      errorBuilder: (_) => CircleAvatar(
+                        radius: 18,
+                        backgroundColor: colors.base200,
+                        child: GfSymbol(
+                          'user-round',
+                          size: 18,
+                          color: colors.iconMuted,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                const SizedBox(width: 10),
+                Expanded(
+                  child: Column(
+                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                    children: [
+                      GfText(
+                        author,
+                        style: TextStyle(
+                          color: colors.baseContent,
+                          fontSize: 14,
+                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
+                        ),
+                      ),
+                      GfText(
+                        '#${post.postNo} · ${timeAgo(post.createdAt, l10n: l10n)}',
+                        style: TextStyle(color: colors.iconMuted, fontSize: 12),
+                      ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ],
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 16),
+            GfMarkdownView(
+              data: post.content,
+              mentions: post.mentions,
+              screenshot: true,
+              colors: colors,
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            GfText(
+              postUrl,
+              style: TextStyle(color: colors.primary, fontSize: 11),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      );
+    },
+  );
+}

+/// Dims the page and, on glass, frosts it, so the menu's glass reads against
+/// a softened backdrop instead of busy content.
+class _FrostedScrim extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _FrostedScrim({required this.animation});
+
+  final Animation<double> animation;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final colors = GfTheme.colorsOf(context);
+    final glass = GfNavigationSurface.usesGlass(context);
+    return IgnorePointer(
+      child: AnimatedBuilder(
+        animation: animation,
+        builder: (context, _) {
+          final t = animation.value;
+          final dim = ColoredBox(
+            color: glass
+                // The frost already separates the menu; dim less than a sheet.
+                ? Colors.black.withValues(
+                    alpha: (colors.isDark ? 0.5 : 0.2) * t,
+                  )
+                : colors.scrim.withValues(alpha: colors.scrim.a * t),
+            child: const SizedBox.expand(),
+          );
+          if (!glass || t == 0) return dim;
+          return BackdropFilter(
+            filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 8 * t, sigmaY: 8 * t),
+            child: dim,
+          );
+        },
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+/// Menu items grow out of the action below them: each rises a little and

+  final Animation<double> animation;
+  final int order;
+  final Widget child;

+  @override

+    final start = math.min(0.4, order * 0.12);
+    final enter = Interval(
+      start,
+      math.min(1, start + 0.6),
+      curve: GfMotion.enterCurve,
+    );
+    return AnimatedBuilder(
+      animation: animation,
+      builder: (context, child) {
+        final leaving = animation.status == AnimationStatus.reverse;
+        final t = leaving
+            ? Curves.easeOutCubic.transform(animation.value)
+            : enter.transform(animation.value);

+/// The 56-pixel title row, taller by [stretch] while a pull stretches it.
+class _StretchingTitleRow extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _StretchingTitleRow({required this.stretch, required this.child});
+
+  final ValueListenable<double>? stretch;
+  final Widget child;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final listenable = stretch;
+    if (listenable == null) return SizedBox(height: 56, child: child);
+    return ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
+      valueListenable: listenable,
+      child: child,
+      builder: (context, extra, child) =>
+          SizedBox(height: 56 + math.max(0, extra), child: child),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// Keeps a side control in the top 56 pixels of a stretched title row.
+class _TopSlot extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _TopSlot({required this.child});
+
+  final Widget child;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
+      SizedBox(height: 56, child: Center(child: child));
+}
+
+/// Moves page content down by [shift] without relayout.
+class _Shifted extends StatelessWidget {
+  const _Shifted({required this.shift, required this.child});
+
+  final ValueListenable<double>? shift;
+  final Widget child;
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final listenable = shift;
+    if (listenable == null) return child;
+    return ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
+      valueListenable: listenable,
+      child: child,
+      builder: (context, offset, child) => Transform.translate(
+        offset: Offset(0, math.max(0, offset)),
+        child: child,
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: false,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',

+    );

+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'dev',
+        preview: true,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://example.com',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://example.com/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );
+  });
+

+      () => AppConfig.validateValues(
+        environment: 'production',
+        preview: false,
+        apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev.yourtj.de',
+        oidcIssuer: 'https://dev.yourtj.de/api/oauth',
+      ),
+      throwsStateError,
+    );

+          p.days.firstWhere((day) => day.date == date).courses;

+        darkTheme: gfThemeData(Brightness.dark),
+        themeMode: mode,

+        onGenerateRoute: _route,

+                ? SystemUiOverlayStyle.light

+  Route<dynamic>? _route(RouteSettings settings) {
+    final uri = Uri.tryParse(settings.name ?? '');

+    final id = segments.last;

+          ? ThemeMode.dark
+          : ThemeMode.light;
+    }
+    final page = [...catalogPages, ...screenPages].where((p) => p.id == id);

+  }

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import test from 'node:test'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { checkTokenMirror, normalizeTokenValue } from './check_token_mirror.mjs'
+
+const cssPath = new URL('../../../../gooseforum/resource/src/styles/tokens.css', import.meta.url)
+const tokenPath = new URL('../lib/src/theme/tokens.json', import.meta.url)
+const css = readFileSync(cssPath, 'utf8')
+const tokens = JSON.parse(readFileSync(tokenPath, 'utf8'))
+
+// Known sRGB references, not values calculated by the implementation under test.
+test('normalizes the supported CSS values into the existing mobile representation', () => {
+  for (const [value, expected] of [
+    ['#ABCDEF', '#abcdef'], ['oklch(100% 0 0)', '#ffffff'],
+    ['oklch(0 0 0)', '#000000'], ['oklch(50% 0 0)', '#636363'],
+    ['oklch(54.6% 0.215 262.88)', '#2563eb'],
+    ['oklch(62.7% 0.194 149.214)', '#00a63e'],
+  ]) assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('color-primary', value), expected)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('radius-box', '0.5rem'), 8)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('border', '1px'), 1)
+  assert.equal(normalizeTokenValue('depth', '1'), 1)
+})
+
+test('unsupported or invalid values fail rather than silently skipping equality', () => {
+  for (const value of ['red', '#fff', 'var(--other)', 'oklch(50% 0.1 0 / .5)', 'oklch(101% 0 0)', 'oklch(50% -1 0)']) {
+    assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('color-primary', value), /Unsupported/)
+  }
+  for (const value of ['calc(1rem)', '1em', 'NaN', '1px junk', '8']) {
+    assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('radius-box', value), /Unsupported/)
+  }
+  assert.throws(() => normalizeTokenValue('depth', '1px'), /Unsupported/)
+})
+
+test('checked-in mirror equals both resolved web themes and CLI works outside the repository', () => {
+  checkTokenMirror(css, tokens)
+  const output = execFileSync(process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(new URL('check_token_mirror.mjs', import.meta.url))], { cwd: tmpdir(), encoding: 'utf8' })
+  assert.match(output, /Token mirror: light and dark values match/)
+})
+
+for (const theme of ['light', 'dark']) {
+  for (const key of ['color-primary', 'color-tooltip-bg', 'radius-box', 'depth']) {
+    test(`detects a changed mobile value: ${theme}/${key}`, () => {
+      const changed = structuredClone(tokens)
+      changed[theme][key] = key.startsWith('color-') ? '#ffffff' : 9
+      assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, changed), new RegExp(`${theme}/${key}`))
+    })
+  }
+}
+
+test('detects a web-only change without changing the mobile mirror', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('oklch(54.6% 0.215 262.88)', '#ffffff'), tokens), /light\/color-primary/)
+})
+
+test('dark inherits root geometry and static colors, but explicit overrides win', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-radius-box: 0.5rem', '--gf-radius-box: 1rem'), tokens), /light\/radius-box[\s\S]*dark\/radius-box/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', '[data-theme="gf-dark"] {\n --gf-radius-box: 1rem;'), tokens), /dark\/radius-box/)
+})
+
+test('missing and extra keys or themes fail; deleting a mirror key cannot bypass checks', () => {
+  const missing = structuredClone(tokens)
+  delete missing.dark['color-primary']
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, missing), /dark\/color-primary/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', ''), tokens), /depth/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', '--gf-depth: 1; --gf-new-token: 2px;'), tokens), /new-token/)
+  const extra = structuredClone(tokens)
+  extra.light['extra-token'] = 1
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, extra), /extra-token/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, { light: tokens.light }), /themes/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css, { ...tokens, other: {} }), /themes/)
+})
+
+test('web-only course and typography tokens do not become mobile component roles', () => {
+  checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-text-xs: 0.6875rem', '--gf-text-xs: 1rem').replace('--gf-color-course-1: oklch(45% 0.19 268)', '--gf-color-course-1: #123456'), tokens)
+})
+
+test('missing theme blocks and duplicate declarations fail closed', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"]', '[data-theme="other"]'), tokens), /theme/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('--gf-depth: 1;', '--gf-depth: 1; --gf-depth: 2;'), tokens), /Duplicate/)
+})
+
+test('selector broadening and conditional theme rules cannot masquerade as global parity', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', ':root,\n[data-theme="gf-dark"] {'), tokens), /selector/)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('[data-theme="gf-light"] {', '[data-theme="gf-light"], body {'), tokens), /selector/)
+  const nested = css.replace('[data-theme="gf-dark"] {', '@media print {\n[data-theme="gf-dark"] {').replace('\n@theme inline', '\n}\n@theme inline')
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(nested, tokens), /nested|Unsupported/)
+})
+
+test('dark overrides must follow root defaults in source order', () => {
+  const blocks = css.match(/[^{}]+\{[^{}]*\}/g)
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror([blocks[1], blocks[0], ...blocks.slice(2)].join('\n'), tokens), /order/)
+})
+
+test('Tailwind alias block cannot redefine the source token values', () => {
+  assert.throws(() => checkTokenMirror(css.replace('@theme inline {', '@theme inline {\n --gf-depth: 2;'), tokens), /selector/)
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import path from 'node:path'
+import test from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import {
+  buildTwemojiManifest,
+  parseDefaultTextPresentationCodepoints,
+} from './generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'
+
+const toolDir = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
+const packageDir = path.resolve(toolDir, '..')
+const unicodeDataPath = path.join(toolDir, 'data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+const flagAssetPath = path.join(
+  packageDir,
+  'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72/1f1f9-1f1fc.png',
+)
+
+test('Unicode 17 text-presentation defaults include copyright, registered, and trademark', () => {
+  const codepoints = parseDefaultTextPresentationCodepoints(
+    readFileSync(unicodeDataPath, 'utf8'),
+  )
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x00a9))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x00ae))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x2122))
+  assert.ok(codepoints.includes(0x2764))
+  assert.ok(!codepoints.includes(0x1f600))
+})
+
+test('manifest generation omits the excluded Taiwan flag but retains other flags', () => {
+  const { entries, excludedSequences } = buildTwemojiManifest([
+    '1f1f9-1f1fc.png',
+    '1f1fa-1f1f8.png',
+    '1f600.png',
+    'e000.png',
+    'not-an-asset.txt',
+  ])
+  const sequences = new Set(entries.map(({ sequence }) => sequence))
+  assert.ok(!sequences.has('🇹🇼'))
+  assert.deepEqual(excludedSequences, ['🇹🇼'])
+  assert.ok(sequences.has('🇺🇸'))
+  assert.ok(sequences.has('😀'))
+})
+
+test('checked-in manifest and Dart map are reproducible and the flag file is absent', () => {
+  execFileSync(
+    process.execPath,
+    [path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), '--check'],
+    { cwd: packageDir, stdio: 'pipe' },
+  )
+  assert.equal(existsSync(flagAssetPath), false)
+
+  const manifest = JSON.parse(
+    readFileSync(path.join(packageDir, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json'), 'utf8'),
+  )
+  assert.equal(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '🇹🇼'), false)
+  assert.deepEqual(manifest.excludedSequences, ['🇹🇼'])
+  assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '🇺🇸'))
+  assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '😀'))
+})
+
+for (const target of ['manifest', 'Dart map', 'asset list', 'Unicode defaults']) {
+  test(`--check rejects stale ${target} without rewriting either generated output`, () => {
+    const fixture = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'twemoji-freshness-'))
+    try {
+      const tool = path.join(fixture, 'tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs')
+      const data = path.join(fixture, 'tool/data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+      const images = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72')
+      const manifest = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json')
+      const dart = path.join(fixture, 'lib/src/twemoji/twemoji_asset_map.g.dart')
+      mkdirSync(path.dirname(data), { recursive: true })
+      mkdirSync(images, { recursive: true })
+      copyFileSync(path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), tool)
+      writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n')
+      // The manifest generator consumes inventory names, not PNG pixel contents.
+      writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f600.png'), '')
+      execFileSync(process.execPath, [tool], { stdio: 'pipe' })
+      if (target === 'manifest') writeFileSync(manifest, '{}\n')
+      if (target === 'Dart map') writeFileSync(dart, '// stale\n')
+      if (target === 'asset list') writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f601.png'), '')
+      if (target === 'Unicode defaults') writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n00ae\n')
+      const before = [readFileSync(manifest, 'utf8'), readFileSync(dart, 'utf8')]
+      assert.throws(
+        () => execFileSync(process.execPath, [tool, '--check'], { stdio: 'pipe' }),
+        (error) => error.status !== 0 && /is stale; regenerate it/.test(error.stderr.toString()),
+      )
+      assert.deepEqual([readFileSync(manifest, 'utf8'), readFileSync(dart, 'utf8')], before)
+    } finally {
+      rmSync(fixture, { recursive: true, force: true })
+    }
+  })
+}
+
+test('CLI invoked through a file alias generates the canonical package outputs', () => {
+  const fixture = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'twemoji-alias-'))
+  try {
+    const tool = path.join(fixture, 'tool/generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs')
+    const alias = path.join(fixture, 'tool/alias.mjs')
+    const data = path.join(fixture, 'tool/data/unicode-emoji-17-default-text.txt')
+    const images = path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-public/twemoji/72x72')
+    mkdirSync(path.dirname(data), { recursive: true })
+    mkdirSync(images, { recursive: true })
+    copyFileSync(path.join(toolDir, 'generate_twemoji_manifest.mjs'), tool)
+    writeFileSync(data, '00a9\n')
+    writeFileSync(path.join(images, '1f600.png'), '')
+    symlinkSync(tool, alias)
+    execFileSync(process.execPath, [alias], { stdio: 'pipe' })
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(fixture, 'assets/twemoji-manifest.json'), 'utf8'))
+    assert.ok(manifest.entries.some(({ sequence }) => sequence === '😀'))
+    assert.ok(existsSync(path.join(fixture, 'lib/src/twemoji/twemoji_asset_map.g.dart')))
+  } finally {
+    rmSync(fixture, { recursive: true, force: true })
+  }
+})

evidence.title: apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh b/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
index 7a4e076d4..e8b737ad0 100755
--- a/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
+++ b/apps/mobile/scripts/build_dev_apk.sh
@@ -3,19 +3,34 @@ set -euo pipefail
 
 # Build a physical-device debug APK against the shared dev backend.
 # Keep the endpoint in build-time defines so local emulator/test defaults stay local.
 SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"
 FORUM_APP_DIR="$SCRIPT_ROOT/apps/mobile/packages/forum_app"
-DEV_API_URL="${YOURTJ_DEV_API_URL:-https://dev.yourtj.de}"
-DEV_OIDC_ISSUER="${YOURTJ_DEV_OIDC_ISSUER:-$DEV_API_URL/api/oauth}"
+DEV_API_URL="https://dev.yourtj.de"
+DEV_OIDC_ISSUER="$DEV_API_URL/api/oauth"
 DEV_CLIENT_ID="${YOURTJ_DEV_CLIENT_ID:-yourtj-mobile}"
 
 cd "$FORUM_APP_DIR"
+shopt -s nullglob
+# A successful command must not make a previous build look like a new APK.
+previous_apks=(build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk)
+if ((${#previous_apks[@]} > 0)); then
+  rm -f -- "${previous_apks[@]}"
+fi
 flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi \
+  --dart-define=YOURTJ_ENVIRONMENT=dev \
+  --dart-define=YOURTJ_PREVIEW=true \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_API_BASE_URL="$DEV_API_URL" \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_OIDC_ISSUER="$DEV_OIDC_ISSUER" \
   --dart-define=YOURTJ_OIDC_CLIENT_ID="$DEV_CLIENT_ID"
 
+apks=(build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk)
+if ((${#apks[@]} == 0)); then
+  printf 'No split debug APKs found under %s/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk\n' \
+    "$FORUM_APP_DIR" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
 printf '\nDev APKs:\n'
-for apk in build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-*-debug.apk; do
+for apk in "${apks[@]}"; do
   printf '  %s\n' "$FORUM_APP_DIR/$apk"
 done
